verdict.rationale: Runpod's Instant Clusters are documented as fully managed multi-node compute with high-performance networking specifically for distributed training, explicitly stating no infrastructure/networking/cluster configuration management is needed, and the broader platform emphasizes self-serve account creation and deployment (no sales-gated flow) via console/CLI/API. missing for 10: no explicit statement that cluster provisioning is entirely self-serve without any sales contact, no technical specs on interconnect (e.g., InfiniBand/NVLink details), and no independent/hands-on benchmark of multi-node training performance.
